title: Selling Plans — FBN Handling Bonus on Discount Dispute Credits
content:
The handling bonus of a discount dispute credit on **Selling Plans** rewards an order that left a Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) fulfillment center quickly after the disputed fee was billed. It reads the outbound shipment recorded for the disputed order in the seller's FBN activity.

**Clause.** The handling bonus of a discount dispute credit is the same-day handling bonus when the disputed order's FBN outbound shipment is dated the same calendar day as the disputed fee record, the next-day handling bonus when it is dated the following calendar day, and nothing when it is dated later or the order has no FBN outbound shipment.

The handling bonus is added to the discount dispute rate of the credit. Bonuses are added together with that rate first and the total is applied once to the variable final value fee billed on the disputed record; no bonus acts on another.

## Input → judgement → output

| FBN outbound shipment of the disputed order | Calendar days after the disputed fee record's date | Handling bonus |
|---|---|---|
| Dated the same day as the fee record | 0 | Same-day handling bonus: 1 percentage point |
| Dated the following day | 1 | Next-day handling bonus: 0.5 percentage point |
| Dated two or more days later | 2 or more | None |
| No FBN outbound shipment recorded for the order | — | None |

## Cases on hypothetical dates (fee record dated 14 March)

- Outbound shipment dated 14 March → 1 point.
- Outbound shipment dated 15 March → 0.5 point.
- Outbound shipment dated 16 March → no handling bonus.
- Order shipped by the seller, with no FBN outbound shipment on record → no handling bonus.
